source_binding.instructions: Current production AGENTS continuity/release rules read. Assessment owns docs only; parent integration, Merchant selection, launch authority and other-platform collectors preserved. No runtime test claims for this assessment.

current_capabilities_and_limits.available: Strict saved raw Salla line observations for last14/previous14/30/90, native currency groups, exact raw timestamp qualification, duplicates/refunds/ambiguous IDs rejected; indexed owner90day discovery query with +/-1 candidate days.
current_capabilities_and_limits.limit: coverage_complete/refunds_reconciled/source_snapshot_immutable false; gross lower bounds only, not net sales or growth. Rejected/oversized/missing rows and1000document cap preclude full ranking.

current_capabilities_and_limits.available: Explicit owner-reviewed prior interval <=366 days, before current start, exact separate prior +/-1 query; owner audit, auth/password and BSON plan fences.
current_capabilities_and_limits.limit: Owner declaration/reference is not verified Hijri/year alignment; no inferred354/365shift, no year-gap union, no growth/profit.

current_capabilities_and_limits.available: Explicit fixed native GET category enumeration and fresh selected1..5 product details/variants, category/store reproof, exclusions, details before-after digest, parent/variant stock separate, source option labels only via proved IDs.
current_capabilities_and_limits.limit: Category traversal is not atomic snapshot. Variants <=2pages/120rows; unknown status/zero-unlimited remains unknown. No size coverage, prep SLA, Merchant mapping, ad readiness or source persistence of native preview.

current_capabilities_and_limits.available: Typed pure future trusted-adapter contract with ISO currency/provenance/cost guards. Hidden/out excluded; candidate labels already exist.
current_capabilities_and_limits.limit: Current adapter intentionally emits incomplete/unverified store records without metrics; pure builder reader_wired false and cannot legitimately turn these into complete growth, product profit or cross-platform winners. Do not bypass complete:false or synthesize verified ProductSourceRecord.

current_capabilities_and_limits.available: Existing append-only effective-dated campaign product graph; proposal intent then verified creation/adoption already supported. Snap completed committed native-day campaign contexts bound owner/account/currency/TZ/attribution and effective association event; context appears once with product references.
current_capabilities_and_limits.limit: Association means intended advertised scope only, not product attribution/feed mapping. Shared multi-product campaign results cannot be allocated or counted per product. Meta needs persisted TZ plus atomic campaign snapshot completeness; TikTok needs persisted native currency and TZ. Provider zero may mean omitted source metric. No retroactive association or conversion addition as independent orders.

current_capabilities_and_limits.available: Current product costs have cache revision/fingerprints; legacy matcher has SKU/product/name fallback. Existing order-item cost snapshots include source item/order/product IDs, cost_complete, cost authority, calculated_at, option/resource components and SAR output.
current_capabilities_and_limits.limit: Currentcost is not historical ordercost. Snapshot endpoint is rebuildable/upserts same order/item key, calculated_at may be later than sale, and cost_complete primarily basecost presence; currency and all-components/returns completeness need separate exactline audit. Do not declare this missing entirely, but do not use it for product profit until audited; no cost writer/accounting mutation.

current_capabilities_and_limits.available: Current fulfillment profiles distinguish inventory behavior from preparation; explicit service requires_preparation can force workflow.
current_capabilities_and_limits.limit: Requires preparation is not preparation duration/deadline SLA; resource links alone do not prove preparation. Keep unknown without trustworthy product/option/time evidence.

recommended_next_slice.name: One owner-triggered product test-review shortlist from existing evidence, not another isolated diagnostic panel
recommended_next_slice.pool: Explicit owner selected1..5 products from freshly verified chosen category; exclude hidden/excluded/nonmember. Do not automatically enumerate all200 into a provider fan-out. Owner choosing category/products is declared scope, not semantic season-fit proof.
recommended_next_slice.trusted_server_orchestration: NEW route captures actual authenticated owner/password state, exact saved Fields/revision/audit, category and selectedIDs. Reuse existing selected_inventory_preview once, read_store_observations once for current90days, prior reader once only when configured, linked_campaign_evidence once. Same frozen server as_of and final owner/plan/store/credential BSON fences. Never accept client supplied verified/native response envelopes as source proof. Existing bounded deadlines remain; totalwork/query caps explicit, no fallback or source sync.
recommended_next_slice.pure_decision_contract: NEW pure function consumes only trusted adapter results bound same owner/plan/revision/selectedIDs and native request, retaining each observation timestamp/digest and context identity. Return one reviewable decision row/product with decision, explicit reasons, missing evidence, source references, separate native-currency/window observations, and once-per-campaign context list. No monetary score, unit-sales ranking or aggregate conversions.

decisions.blocked: Excluded, hidden/out/is_availablefalse, identity/category mismatch. Unknown is never converted into out-of-stock.
decisions.needs_stock_or_fit_review: Unknown/missing/stale native stock or owner season-fit not explicitly reviewed; show concrete missing inputs.
decisions.supported_test_review: Owner-reviewed season fit and positive bounded native stock observation; positive raw current/prior observations or historically valid shared campaign context provide clearly labelled supporting reasons, not product success proof.
decisions.exploration_test_review: Owner-reviewed fit plus positive bounded stock but no qualified history. Do not infer newly launched/new product or zero sales; expose history unknown. This lane prevents lack of sales history from excluding suitable product experiments.

recommended_next_slice.ordering: Rank review readiness in explicit lanes, preserve owner pinned order within each lane; evidence presence can annotate review priority but never assert expected profit/Google success. Do not penalize exploration solely for missing history; no invented numeric weights. Product season-fit needs explicit owner declaration stored later in existing plan review, not parsed guesses from title/season text.
recommended_next_slice.authority: Every row execution_authorized:false, paid_launch_eligible:false, profitability:null, growth:null, approved_test_budget:null/not_checked. Saved commercial limits or instruction are not grant. Root launch/grant pipeline independently validates real approved test budget before any creation/activation; no proposal budget allocation by this slice.
recommended_next_slice.cost_and_prep: Always show current_cost/historical_cost/complete_margin/preparation_duration unknown until separate audited adapter supports them; no currentcost multiplied into historic orders. Can show source costs as unverified availability only after explicit adapter, not first slice.
recommended_next_slice.actual_use: One explicit Review candidates action in owner plan produces concise table: product, review decision, evidence reasons, missingfit/stock/cost/prep/authority, source contexts, owner-selected next action. Root integrates this instead of adding another generic unconnected readiness UI. No automatic selection/save/launch.

proposed_ownership_if_assigned.later_root_owned: One shared router attach and existing owner-plan summary/table integration after coherent root source. Any persisted per-product owner season-fit field belongs coordinated CommercialPlanFields/form owner; do not invent generic write API.
proposed_ownership_if_assigned.do_not_touch: Existing raw order/global normalizers, product/cost/Salla writers, graph generic writer, otherplatform collectors, Merchant identity selector, launch/budget/authorization, frozen accepted source files.

acceptance_regressions_before_implementa: ActualHTTPwriter→newserverreview with same savedplan and owner identity; fresh-owner disabled/role/deletion/password changes before/during read, duplicateowner and BSON numeric aliases all fail closed.
Same current14/14+30/90 qualifier outputs unchanged; explicitprior separatequery<=366days/no uniongap; unknowncoverage never produces growth/metric ranking.
Nativecategory/store/credential/productdrift, exclusions, hidden/out/unknown, parentpositive with zerovariants or unknownunlimited do not claim purchasability/globalready; no arbitrary URL fetch.
No positive store observations is history unknown, not new/zero-demand. Exploration remains reviewable with explicitfit and boundedpositive stock; no approved budget synthesized.

Sharedcampaign context linking2products remains onecontext, two references; lateassociation cannot inherit historical signal; platform/account/currency/TZ/attribution/period partitions never merge; Meta/TikTok gaps explicit.
Missing/rebuildable/currentcost is not historical cost; negative/zero/pending/partial cost never manufactured profit. Requires_preparation is not duration; no winner inference from sales/ROAS alone.

RealMongo source projection/owner/plan race gates and actualwriter fixture, no skips; response service validates source binding and final parent UI cancels dirty/fullfields/owner/revision changes. No provider mutation or paid execution.
